# パラメータ
L = 50
t = 1.0
U = 4.0
N_up = 25
N_down = 25
boundary = "OBC"

# 計算の設定
mixing = 0.25
tol = 1.0e-10
maxiter = 10000

# 初期電子密度
initial_mode = :manual
amplitude = 0.1
seed = 20261101
rng = MersenneTwister(seed)
patterns = [rand(rng, L) .- 0.5 for spin in 1:2]
for values in patterns
    values .-= sum(values) / L
    values ./= maximum(abs.(values))
end
up0 = N_up / L .+ amplitude .* patterns[1]
down0 = N_down / L .+ amplitude .* patterns[2]
